lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council session, which opens with a deep dive into Comprehensive Plan goals and a third-party audit review of the Town's rental housing policies — that audit question cuts right to the heart of who gets to live here long-term. Wednesday's Ouray County Planning Commission is meeting virtually to work through possible Land Use Code definition changes, which is the kind of quiet session where big things get shaped before anyone notices. The Mountain Village Design Review Board also takes up a conditional-use permit on Adams Ranch Road Thursday.

notable.stake: Rental housing audit review and Comprehensive Plan goals could reshape who stays in the canyon.
Land Use Code definition changes under review — early shaping before any public hearing.
Conditional-use permit for tent and food truck on Adams Ranch Rd goes to DRB for recommendation.
